decisions.reason: Faithfully preserves Orfevre's imperious command and the contrast between disrespect and reverent submission; the locked name Orfevre is present and natural in context.
Accurately carries Gentildonna's winner-is-justice assertion and vow to make everything submit; the locked name is preserved.
The self-introduction, determination to keep working, and refusal to be discouraged by strong peers are all faithfully rendered; Win Variation matches the locked term.
Meaning and restrained tone are preserved: sweetness/gentleness are unnecessary and self-improvement is the sole aim; Admire Groove matches the locked term.
Faithfully mirrors the source's expedition invitation, dreamlike journey wording, and intentionally incomplete final clause; Dream Journey matches the locked term.
The terse self-introduction and fastest-speed obsession are preserved cleanly, including the preference for straights; Calstone Light O matches the locked term.
Faithfully renders the holy-sword imagery, cutting down disloyal darkness, and knightly oath/loyalty persona; Durandal matches the locked term.
Preserves the declaration, charge-captain role, Four Heavenly Kings whirlwind image, and invitation to let dreams grow; Vietnamese is coherent and faithful.
Accurately keeps Sakura Chitose O's dietary advice and traditional qi-blood-water balance wording without dropping meaning; the locked name is present.
Preserves Fenomeno's formal self-reference, Central Tracen affiliation, and resolve to spare no effort as a model for children; both locked terms are correct.
Blast Onepiece's affectionate enthusiasm toward humans and desire for lots of friendly contact are accurately preserved; the locked name is correct.
Accurately preserves Almond Eye's resolve to beat even legends and her self-focused conviction; the locked name is correct.

decisions.proposed_text: Hi!　Tôi là Forever Young!\nLộ trình đã sẵn sàng! Phải tạo nên một cuộc\ncách mạng trong thế giới Mã Nương chứ, đúng không!
decisions.reason: The sentence meaning and Forever Young name are correct, but generic 赛马娘 is currently rendered with the forbidden project term Uma Musume.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.world.umamusume requires generic 赛马娘 → Mã Nương and explicitly forbids Uma Musume outside established proper race names.

decisions.proposed_text: Xin chào, tôi là Aoi Kiryuin.\nDù vẫn còn non nớt với tư cách Trainer mới của Học viện Tracen,\nnhưng vì tương lai của các Mã Nương, tôi sẽ dốc hết sức cố gắng!
decisions.reason: The meaning and locked Học viện Tracen term are sound, but both generic player/world terms use forbidden forms in the current text.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.trainer requires 训练员 → Trainer and common.world.umamusume requires generic 赛马娘 → Mã Nương; Huấn luyện viên and Uma Musume are explicitly forbidden here.

decisions.proposed_text: Tôi là thầy châm cứu Sasami Anshinzawa lành nghề (học việc) đây.\nNếu để tôi châm một cái, Power sẽ tăng “phụt” lên!\nWow, an～tâm☆
decisions.reason: The playful needle-treatment line is otherwise preserved, but 力量 refers to the game Power stat in this stat-increase context and the current Vietnamese calque is forbidden.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.stat.power requires stat-context 力量 → Power and forbids Sức mạnh; the explicit stat-increase wording makes the stat reading applicable rather than ordinary physical strength.
